meta.name: json-canvas
meta.description: Create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas) with nodes, edges, groups, and connections. Use when working with .canvas files, creating visual canvases, mind maps, flowcharts, or when the user mentions Canvas files in Obsidian.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建和编辑 JSON Canvas 文件，构建可视化画布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Obsidian 中创建和编辑 .canvas 文件
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit JSON Canvas files for visual canvases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and edit .canvas files in Obsidian

howto.what: 生成和编辑 .canvas 文件,内容为 nodes 与 edges 两类数组;支持文本、文件、链接、分组四种节点,可设置位置、尺寸、颜色、连线及组标签等属性。
howto.when: 当你提到 .canvas 文件,或要求画思维导图、流程图等画布内容时。

say.text: 帮我新建一个 .canvas 文件,放三个文本节点并连线。
把这个画布改成流程图,给节点加上不同颜色和箭头。
say.note: 会调整节点颜色、连线方向与端点形状。

say.text: 在画布里加入一个文件节点,指向 Notes 文件夹中的某篇笔记。
say.note: 会生成 file 类型节点,可带 subpath 指向标题。

howto.what_en: Creates and edits .canvas files containing nodes and edges arrays; supports text, file, link, and group node types with position, size, color, connections, and group labels.
howto.when_en: When the user mentions .canvas files, or asks for mind maps, flowcharts, or similar canvas content.

say_en.text: Create a new .canvas file with three text nodes connected.
say_en.note: Generates a JSON canvas with nodes and edges.

say_en.text: Turn this canvas into a flowchart with colored nodes and arrows.
say_en.note: Adjusts colors, edge directions, and endpoint shapes.

say_en.text: Add a file node pointing to a note in the Notes folder.
say_en.note: Creates a file-type node, optionally with a subpath.
